segments.text_template: A balanced chemical equation contains equal numbers of atoms of each element on the reactant and product sides. Balancing is performed by changing coefficients, not the subscripts in the specified chemical formulas. Two water molecules contain four hydrogen atoms and two oxygen atoms. Verification requires counting each element on both sides.
